summary: CellarBoss is a self-hosted inventory management system designed specifically for tracking wine collections. It runs via Docker and Node.js under the GPL-3.0 licence, providing a structured way to catalogue bottles, locations, and stock levels on your own hardware.
goodFor: This is a suitable tool for individuals or small-scale collectors who want a dedicated, local system to track their wine inventory rather than relying on commercial cloud services.
watchOut: With only a modest community following and early-stage versioning, you may encounter missing features, undocumented edge cases, or sparse troubleshooting documentation.
deployNotes: As a containerised Node.js application, deployment typically requires mounting persistent volumes for your data storage and configuring a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
